name: aya.neco.proof-lab
summary: Local-first proof economy module for demo rewards, impact claims, receipts, and proof envelopes.

commands.name: aya.issueCommonGood
commands.description: Apply common-good issuance rules and create a demo ledger event.

commands.name: aya.createImpactClaim
commands.description: Convert kg CO2e into Planedo-style demo units and create a ledger event.

commands.name: aya.applyDecay
commands.description: Apply monthly Gradido-style transience to a demo balance.

commands.name: aya.exportReceipt
commands.description: Export balances and ledger events as a receipt.

commands.name: aya.wrapReceiptForWoda
commands.description: Wrap a receipt into a WODA-routable object envelope.
